prompt: Write a single, self-contained prompt for a text-to-image model that has never heard of Chinese memes, so that it draws a cat version of the "大笑奶龙" (Laughing Nailong / 奶蛙) meme. Output only the prompt.
answer:
A crude, simple cartoon sticker of an extremely fat cat drawn as a round yellow-orange blob: an oversized spherical head merging directly into a pear-shaped body with no neck, tiny stubby short arms and legs, small triangular cat ears, a short thick tail, two whisker dots on each cheek, flat pale-yellow belly patch, thick uneven black outlines, flat cel-shaded coloring with no gradients or texture, deliberately low-effort childish doodle style.

Expression: roaring with obnoxious laughter — head tilted back and slightly to one side, mouth stretched enormously wide open into a huge upward-curving cavern that covers most of the lower face, bright pink mouth interior with a small tongue and two tiny white fangs at the top, both eyes squeezed shut into thick upward-arching crescent lines, eyebrows raised high, cheeks puffed and blushing, one tiny paw slapping its own round belly, the other flung up in the air, whole body squashed and wobbling with laughter.

Framing: single character, front-facing, centered, waist-up, filling the frame, plain flat white background, no text, no watermark, no extra objects, reaction-image / messaging-app sticker aesthetic, smug and gleeful and slightly unhinged mood.
